blocks.en: A number of groups in New Eden host publicly-accessible PvP fleets that fly on a "not purple, shoot it" basis ("NPSI"), that is, set out to engage any target they can find which isn't part of the fleet. EVE University members are welcome to fly in such fleets, subject to the considerations listed at the bottom of this page.
blocks.zh: 新伊甸有不少团体会组织面向所有人开放的 PvP 舰队，奉行“不是紫名就开火”（"not purple, shoot it"，简称“NPSI”）原则，也就是说，只要发现的目标不在舰队里，就主动出击。欢迎 EVE University 成员参加这类舰队，但需遵守本页末尾列出的注意事项。

blocks.en: This is a list of several groups that periodically host NPSI PvP fleets.
blocks.zh: 以下是几个定期组织 NPSI PvP 舰队的团体。

blocks.en: Bombers Bar
blocks.zh: Bombers 巴尔

blocks.en: As at 2022, the Bombers Bar (BB) is in full swing. There are a number of people in specific corps that devote a lot of their game time to leading and supporting BB.
blocks.zh: 截至 2022 年，Bombers 巴尔（BB）正如火如荼地运作。一些特定军团里有不少人把大量游戏时间投入到带领和支持 BB 上。

blocks.en: BB flies public Stealth Bomber fleets in which all are welcome. There is minimal/no politics and the fleet flies NPSI (Not Purple Shoot It aka anything outside of the fleet can be shot). Some fleets include more than 100 attendees so it often creates some ethical issues if the fleet goes into allied space of one or more fleet members and the individual needs to decide whether they can engage allies/friendlies/blues.
blocks.zh: BB 组织公开的隐形轰炸舰舰队，欢迎所有人参加。舰队几乎不涉及政治，奉行 NPSI（不是紫名就开火，即舰队之外的任何目标都可以打）。有些舰队参与人数超过 100 人，因此如果舰队进入了某个或某几个成员的盟友空间，往往会带来一些道德难题，个人需要自己决定是否能对盟友/友方/蓝名开火。

blocks.en: BB runs some different fleets from roaming through space to using covert cynosural fields and black ops ships to drop into Null Sec and Wormhole space to blow up expensive ships and fleets.
blocks.zh: BB 会组织各种不同的舰队，有的在宇宙中游荡，有的利用隐秘诱导力场和黑隐特勤舰空降到 00 区和虫洞空间，击毁昂贵的舰船和舰队。

blocks.en: Generally, the essential skill to join a BB fleet is to be able to use a Covert Ops Cloaking Device II which requires Cloaking IV. The ability to fly a bomber that can deliver bombs and torpedoes is also a mainstay of the fleet. However, fleets tend to require hunter/scouts, tacklers/bubblers, ECM, loot ships and more. More advanced pilots might fly Black Ops and other ships in support of fleets. Just make sure that you have the right doctrine/ship organised early for the fleet that you are attending.
blocks.zh: 一般来说，加入 BB 舰队的必备技能是能使用隐形理论 IV 才能装配的隐秘行动隐形装置 II。能驾驶投掷炸弹和发射鱼雷的轰炸舰也是舰队的主力。不过，舰队通常还需要猎手/侦察、拦截/放泡、ECM、捡垃圾船等等。更资深的飞行员可能会驾驶黑隐特勤舰或其他舰船为舰队提供支援。只要确保你提前为所参加的舰队准备好正确的配置方案和舰船即可。

blocks.en: Details on upcoming fleets, fittings, fleet instructions, and joining comms can be found in the in-game channel (join 'Bombers Bar'). Usually, each fleet will specify a form-up system and time. At the allotted time, the FC will update the channel Message of the Day (MOTD) with an extra channel in which to X-up to join the fleet. This involves entering the temporary channel and sending an X in the channel chat - someone will send you a fleet invite. Roams may start from the form-up point, other types of fleets might specify a staging system to start heading to as the FC starts to provide more instructions.
blocks.zh: 即将开始的舰队、装配、舰队说明以及加入语音的详情，可以在游戏内频道中找到（加入“Bombers 巴尔”频道）。通常每支舰队会指定一个集结星系和时间。到了约定时间，FC 会在频道的每日消息（MOTD）中更新一个额外频道，在里面扣 X 加入舰队。具体做法是进入那个临时频道，在聊天里发一个 X，就会有人给你发舰队邀请。游荡舰队可能从集结点直接出发，其他类型的舰队可能会指定一个前进基地星系，FC 开始下达更多指令时你就要往那里赶。

blocks.en: It is essential to be in comms to hear, sometimes at very short-notice, instructions from the Fleet Commander if a target has been found by hunters/scouts. Sometimes a blingy ship is found and the time to bridge/jump and engage the ship is very short. New pilots are always welcome but should expect to spend the first fleet getting used to the fleet mechanics to master landing effectively, delivering bombs, getting in on big kills, and getting out safely. The environment is often very friendly though and worth attending.
blocks.zh: 必须进入语音，才能听到舰队指挥的指令——当猎手/侦察发现目标时，这些指令有时来得非常突然。有时发现一艘豪华装配的船，留给开桥/跳跃和交战的时间非常短。新飞行员随时欢迎，但第一次参加时预计要花时间熟悉舰队机制，学会高效落点、投弹、在大型击杀中蹭上伤害，以及安全撤离。不过整体氛围通常非常友好，值得参加。

blocks.en: Ship replacement, through Obombercare, is generous and funded by blingy loot that is regularly collected from wrecks during fleets.
blocks.zh: 通过 Obombercare 提供的舰船补损相当慷慨，资金来自舰队行动中经常从残骸里捡到的高价战利品。

blocks.en: BB is often an excellent opportunity to build killboard stats - to get involved in small or large-scale kills but also to build knowledge and skills which contribute to EVE Uni titles. It is also a chance to operate in a larger scale fleets and enthusiastic capsuleers.
blocks.zh: BB 往往是刷击毁记录战绩的绝佳机会——既能参与小规模或大规模的击杀，也能积累有助于获得 EVE Uni 头衔的知识和技能。这也是一个和众多热情的克隆飞行员一起参与更大规模舰队行动的机会。

blocks.en: Spectre Fleet
blocks.zh: Spectre Fleet

blocks.en: Spectre Fleet (SF) is a public NPSI fleet (Not Purple Shoot It - meaning anyone not in the fleet is a potential target). The previous link to the Specter Fleet calendar identifies the time/date for upcoming fleets and provides links to the appropriate additional information as needed for each fleet. Many of those resources are in-game via the Specter Fleet chat channels where the MOTD will guide prospective pilots to the right places.
blocks.zh: Spectre Fleet（SF）是一支公开的 NPSI 舰队（不是紫名就开火——即任何不在舰队中的人都是潜在目标）。上面链接的 Spectre Fleet 日程表列出了即将开始的舰队的日期和时间，并根据需要为每支舰队提供相应补充信息的链接。其中许多资源在游戏内的 Spectre Fleet 聊天频道中，频道的 MOTD 会引导有意参加的飞行员前往正确的地方。

blocks.en: Having spies (spais) is an unfortunate part of public fleets but it is generally kept to a minimum. If a fleet is spending time in an area blue to one or more fleet members, there is an unwritten rule that fleet members won't give the game away (whether or not they participate in battles/kills).
blocks.zh: 间谍（spais）是公开舰队中难以避免的问题，但一般会被控制在最低限度。如果舰队在某个对一名或多名成员来说是蓝名的区域活动，有一条不成文的规矩：这些成员不能走漏风声（无论他们是否参与战斗/击杀）。

blocks.en: SF flies many different doctrines in regular fleets and can be a lot of fun and a supportive environment. As with other public fleets, some SF fleets move quite quickly and are not a good choice for your first fleet; however, once you have basic fleet commands down they are not hard to participate in and are highly encouraged. Any experience in basic fleet mechanics, coupled with the essential SF (or BB) fleet instructional videos, is quite helpful, as are the EVE University CORE classes. It is important to note that the EVE University Ship Replacement Program is not standard on SF fleets but that SF FCs SRP their own fleets in most cases. Verify with the FC prior to undocking to be sure you are comfortable with the risk potential.
blocks.zh: SF 的常规舰队会使用许多不同的配置方案，玩起来很有乐趣，氛围也很友善。和其他公开舰队一样，有些 SF 舰队节奏很快，不适合作为你的第一次舰队经历；不过一旦掌握了基本的舰队指令，参与起来并不难，非常推荐。任何基础舰队机制方面的经验，加上 SF（或 BB）必看的舰队教学视频，都会很有帮助，EVE University 的 CORE 课程也是如此。需要特别注意的是，EVE University 的舰船补损计划（SRP）通常不适用于 SF 舰队，但大多数情况下 SF 的 FC 会为自己的舰队提供补损。离站之前请先和 FC 确认，确保你能接受潜在的风险。

blocks.en: Details on upcoming SF fleets, fittings, fleet instructions, and joining comms can be found in the in-game channel (join 'SF Spectre Fleet'). As with BB, carefully check the doctrine/fittings and the staging system to ensure that you are there on time in the right ship (and not being 10-20 jumps away as the fleet starts moving).
blocks.zh: 即将开始的 SF 舰队、装配、舰队说明以及加入语音的详情，可以在游戏内频道中找到（加入“SF Spectre Fleet”频道）。和 BB 一样，请仔细检查配置方案/装配和前进基地星系，确保你按时驾驶正确的船到达（而不是在舰队出发时还在 10-20 跳之外）。

blocks.en: FUN inc / Even Better With Friends [EBWF]
blocks.zh: FUN inc / Even Better With Friends [EBWF]（意为“和朋友一起更好”）

blocks.en: EBWF is another public fleet option with different NPSI fleets.
blocks.zh: EBWF 是另一个公开舰队选择，有各种不同的 NPSI 舰队。

blocks.en: Founded in 2018 as a safe haven for small gang PvPers after the demise of Agony Unleashed FUN inc / Even Better With Friends is an EU TZ Nullsec PVP corp and NPSI group, specialising in nullsec solo, small gang, and microgang combat who fight almost entirely in Nullsec.
blocks.zh: FUN inc / Even Better With Friends 成立于 2018 年，在 Agony Unleashed 解散后作为小队 PvP 玩家的避风港而建立。它是一个欧洲时区（EU TZ）的 00 区 PvP 军团和 NPSI 团体，专注于 00 区单人、小队和微型小队作战，几乎完全在 00 区战斗。

blocks.en: They are a corporation in their own right and when the NPSI roams take place they roam freely, engaging whoever they like, and have created a no drama PVP community that roams Nullsec looking for good fights.
blocks.zh: 他们本身是一个独立军团，进行 NPSI 游荡时自由行动，想打谁就打谁，打造了一个没有纷争、在 00 区游荡寻找好架打的 PvP 社区。

blocks.en: FUN inc / Even Better With Friends has an active Discord community server that affords the community opt-in sub-channels for ship fittings, for timezone specific and NPSI roles which allow you to team up with other likeminded bloodthirsty PVPers and roam with FUN inc.
blocks.zh: FUN inc / Even Better With Friends 拥有一个活跃的 Discord 社区服务器，社区成员可以自选加入舰船装配、特定时区以及 NPSI 身份组等子频道，让你可以和其他志同道合、嗜血好战的 PvP 玩家组队，跟着 FUN inc 一起游荡。

blocks.en: 'EBWF NPSI calendar' The aim of the FUN inc NPSI community gateway is to showcase some of the best NPSI PVP content creators out there. This site will act as a springboard for community engagement and cross harmonisation of groups, with the sole intent of promoting variety and visibility of content, focusing on developing new relationships within EVE online.
blocks.zh: “EBWF NPSI 日程表” FUN inc NPSI 社区门户旨在展示一些最优秀的 NPSI PvP 内容创作者。该网站将作为促进社区参与和各团体协同的跳板，唯一目的是提升内容的多样性和曝光度，着重在 EVE Online 中建立新的联系。

blocks.en: Join the 'EBWF public' in-game to get involved.
blocks.zh: 在游戏内加入“EBWF public”频道即可参与。

blocks.en: The Ancients
blocks.zh: The Ancients

blocks.en: The Ancients is a new collaboration between various NPSI Fleet Commanders and potentially brings together a number of fleets.
blocks.zh: The Ancients 是多位 NPSI 舰队指挥之间的新合作项目，有望把多支舰队聚集在一起。

blocks.en: Arataka Research Consortium
blocks.zh: Arataka Research Consortium

blocks.en: ARC (in-game channel 'Consortium Operations') are a public group of xenological researchers. Their more core members are consistently active on the Roleplay forums, gathering and reporting information on the Drifters and the Triglavian Collective.
blocks.zh: ARC（游戏内频道“Consortium Operations”）是一个公开的异种学研究团体。其核心成员一直活跃在角色扮演论坛上，收集并报告有关流浪者和三神裔的信息。

blocks.en: During the Triglavian Invasion, ARC hosted EDENCOM-friendly public fleets, using heavy armor to run Major Conduits and Observatory Flashpoints during Chapter 2, and using a variety of fleet compositions to engage Emerging Conduits and various Triglavian infrastructure during Chapter 3. With the end of the Invasion, and the creation of Pochven, ARC began hosting "Dual-Standings" fleets in Pochven, entering and exiting via Filament, and hunting Drifters and Rogue Drones to gain positive standings with both the Triglavian Collective and EDENCOM. At present, ARC's dual-standings fleets are based on Muninns. Due to the unpredictable nature of Filaments, dual-standings fleets are not drop-in/drop-out, and pilots must be in the fleet from when it forms to when it disbands.
blocks.zh: 在三神裔入侵期间，ARC 组织了亲伊甸联合防御阵线的公开舰队：在第二章中使用重装甲舰队刷主要通道（Major Conduits）和观测站热点（Observatory Flashpoints），在第三章中使用各种舰队配置攻打新兴通道（Emerging Conduits）和各类三神裔设施。入侵结束、波赫文形成后，ARC 开始在波赫文组织“双声望”舰队，通过纤维进出，猎杀流浪者和自由无人机，以同时提升对三神裔和伊甸联合防御阵线的声望。目前，ARC 的双声望舰队以缪宁级为主力。由于纤维的不可预测性，双声望舰队不能中途加入或离开，飞行员必须从舰队组建一直待到解散。

blocks.en: Prior to the Triglavian Invasion, ARC made a name for themselves as being one of the only organizations in New Eden to host periodic Drifter Hive Fleets, in which groups of ships fly into Drifter-occupied Unidentified Wormholes and attack their inhabitants head-on. These fleets are still held periodically, using mainly Confessors.
blocks.zh: 在三神裔入侵之前，ARC 就以新伊甸为数不多会定期组织流浪者巢穴舰队的组织之一而闻名：一群舰船飞进被流浪者占据的未知虫洞，正面攻击里面的守军。这类舰队现在仍会定期举行，主要使用忏悔者级。

blocks.en: Considerations
blocks.zh: 注意事项

blocks.en: Remember the EVE University Rules, including restrictions on attacking structures and involvement in any wars or pseudo wars. If in doubt, err on the side of caution so that all of our unistas don't inadvertently become war targets outside our rules.
blocks.zh: 请牢记 EVE University 规章，包括关于攻击建筑以及卷入任何战争或准战争的限制。如有疑问，宁可谨慎行事，以免我们的 Uni 成员无意中在规章之外成为战争目标。

blocks.en: Although the fleets are NPSI, it is still very important to follow the rules and minimise engagement with our friends and allies (+5 to +10 blue status with EVE Uni or Ivy League). NPSI fleets are generally quite aware and supportive of fleet members not engaging their allies. In short, Unistas and Unista alts should not shoot Unistas (unless permission is given).
blocks.zh: 虽然这些舰队奉行 NPSI，但遵守规章、尽量避免与我们的朋友和盟友（对 EVE Uni 或 Ivy League 声望为 +5 到 +10 的蓝名）交战仍然非常重要。NPSI 舰队通常都很清楚并支持舰队成员不攻击自己的盟友。简而言之，Uni 成员及其小号不应攻击 Uni 成员（除非获得许可）。
